evaluation_function: Expected min(remaining goal, delivered at tick 3 minus current delivered) minus 0.25 * sum(queue ticks 1..3) minus 0.1 * root amount; tie lower amount
freeze: v2 frozen before pilot/main results; v1 retained as superseded diagnostic protocol because its 32-call budget cannot accommodate the 72-call promotion evaluation replay plus 3 selection forecasts. Weights, thresholds and seeds unchanged.
limits: Single selected candidate; Gate rejection ends the round without an alternative
Public minimum-service candidate filter applied to all five configurations; independent Gate still required
Historical service iid/stationary assumption; uncertainty ranges are not safety certificates
Partial ordinary observations may never identify service or make health available
Actual closed-loop outcomes are scored only against immediate executed forecast; H3 and action differences use separate formally executed diagnostic branches
Multiple seeds in noiseless fixtures test reproducibility, not generalization
Warmup and recovery preparation actions, ticks and costs are counted separately and explicitly
Runtime call accounting includes completed local promotion evaluation replay predictions; no external API or execution receipts are invented.
